title: Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss 'world peace' at Shenzhen summit, China says

contentText: The Chinese foreign ministry on Monday said that President Xi Jinping and his US and Russian counterparts Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin would discuss "safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability" when they hold their first trilateral summit in Shenzhen this week. The meeting is expected to happen on Thursday on the sidelines of a summit of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders.
